select SUBSTR(created_at,1,10) as date,SUM(amount) as amount,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN exception='Matched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matched,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN exception NOT IN ('Matched','For Review','Cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as exceptions,
                    SUM(CASE WHEN exception='For Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as review from (select `e`.*, CASE WHEN exception='Matched' THEN 'matched' ELSE 'open' END as review_status,
                0 as review_revision,NULL as review_reason,NULL as owner_id,NULL as priority,NULL as review_due_at,NULL as closure_evidence,NULL as reviewed_at from (select `d`.*, CASE
            WHEN reconciliation_prefix<>'' THEN reconciliation_prefix
            WHEN identity_count>1 AND document_family IN ('credit','debit') THEN 'Adjustment Reference Unverified'
            WHEN identity_count>1 THEN 'Duplicate Receipt Reference'
            ELSE reconciliation_suffix END as exception from (select `id`, `reconciliation_prefix`, `reconciliation_suffix`, `identity_count`, `document_family`, `amount`, `vat_amount`, `vatable_sales`, `created_at`, `business` from `ledger_documents` as `ledger` force index (ledger_reconciliation_summary) where `identity_rank` = ? and `is_draft` = ?) as `d`) as `e`) as `cases` group by `date` order by `date` desc limit 7

select COUNT(*) as total,COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) as sales,
                    COALESCE(SUM(vat_amount),0) as vat,COALESCE(SUM(vatable_sales),0) as taxable,COALESCE(AVG(amount),0) as average,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN exception='Matched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as matched,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN exception NOT IN ('Matched','For Review','Cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as exceptions,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN exception='For Review' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as review,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status='resolved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as resolved,
                    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status='resolved' AND reviewed_at>=? AND reviewed_at<? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) as reconciled_today from (select `e`.*, CASE WHEN exception='Matched' THEN 'matched' ELSE 'open' END as review_status,

            WHEN reconciliation_prefix<>'' THEN reconciliation_prefix
